product.name: Magnetic Encoder Disc for 20D mm Metal Gearmotors, OD 9.7 mm, ID 2.0 mm, 20 CPR (Bulk)

warnings: The dimensions come from the supplied listing (OD 9.7 mm, ID 2.0 mm, 2 mm thick), which is marked unverified. The image proportions match them: the bore is about 0.2 of the diameter and the thickness is about a fifth of it. The through-bore is assumed from the visible light at the bottom of the hole. The two circular marks on the face are not dimensioned, so I did not model them or give their positions or sizes. The bore appears to run along the disc's flat-face normal (z axis).
Dimensions come from the unverified listing.
The two small circular marks on one face are uncertain (they may be magnetized pole regions rather than geometry), so they are omitted.
The through-bore is assumed from the light visible at the bottom of the hole.
The image suggests the bore may be slightly tapered or stepped, but this is uncertain, so a straight bore is used.
